mapper.select: select count(*) from wf_form where create_user_id = any (select u.user_id from b_user u, b_role r, r_user_role ur where u.flag = 1 and r.flag = 1 and ur.flag = 1 and u.user_id = ur.user_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id and u.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and r.code = 'applet_user' and u.last_login_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime})

select t.* , case when ssc.code is null then '否' else '是' end as contract_signed_flag , ssc.code as contract_code , ssc.name as contract_name , DATE_FORMAT(ssc.signing_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as contract_signing_time , ssc.amount as contract_amount from () as t left join sc_service_contract ssc on ssc.form_id = t.form_id and ssc.flag = 1
